Title: ViewStartAttribute - Starting View Marker
Summary: Class-level attribute that marks a Blazor component as a possible starting view. Used in conjunction with IViewStartProvider to expose startup pages to the user.
Content:
# ViewStartAttribute

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Attributes`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Components.Core`

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class, AllowMultiple = false)]
public class ViewStartAttribute : Attribute
{
    public ViewStartAttribute(string id, string title, string? description = null);
    public string Id { get; }
    public string Title { get; }
    public string? Description { get; }
}
```

Marks a Blazor component class as a possible starting view. The shell UI enumerates classes carrying this attribute (typically via an `IViewStartProvider`) and offers them to the user as selectable startup pages.

## Constructor

```csharp
public ViewStartAttribute(string id, string title, string? description = null);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | Unique identifier for the view. Used as the routing key. |
| `title` | `string` | Display title shown in the UI. |
| `description` | `string?` | Optional longer description. Defaults to `null`. |

## Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Id` | `string` | Routing/identifier string. |
| `Title` | `string` | Display title. |
| `Description` | `string?` | Optional description. |

## Usage

```csharp
[ViewStart("my-extension", "My Extension", "Custom extension page")]
public partial class MyExtensionPage : ComponentBase { }
```

## Notes
- `AllowMultiple = false` — only one `[ViewStart]` per class.
- The attribute is class-targeted only; do not apply to properties or methods.
- This is an alternative to implementing `IViewStartProvider` programmatically.

## Related
- `IViewStartProvider` — the runtime contract that yields `ViewStart` entries
- `ViewStart` (Cyrena.Core) — the model returned by providers
